profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Cloneable.ai | Veteran
profile.summary:
I build web applications used by millions—eCommerce platforms, government analytics dashboards, civic tech tools. The kind of engineering work where performance, accessibility, and user experience actually matter.

3+ years as a full-stack developer, primarily Vue.js/Nuxt/TypeScript, with Node.js and increasingly Laravel on the backend. Marine Corps veteran (Combat Videographer, 2009-2014) turned software engineer—turns out the skills transfer well.

Currently building PoliHeel (poli-heel.vercel.app), a Nuxt 4 platform that makes congressional data accessible to everyday people. In addition, its sister React-Native mobile app.  Legislator information, user login to follow legislators, voting records, AI-assisted analysis—all in one place. It's my laboratory for learning React, Laravel, API integration, and modern full-stack patterns.

What I bring:
- Vue.js/Nuxt (3+ years), TypeScript, JavaScript, React (learning)
- Laravel/PHP, Node.js, PostgreSQL, RESTful APIs
- Analytics-driven development (GA4, BigQuery), data visualization
- AWS serverless (Lambda, S3, CloudFront), Vercel deployments
- WCAG accessibility compliance, performance optimization
- Public Trust clearance (2023-2025) | Secret (Marine Corps, 2009-2014)

Product-minded engineering is my thing—understanding the "why" behind features, not just the "how."

Open to conversations about interesting projects, modern web architecture, developer tools, or civic tech. Let's connect!

projects.title: PoliHeel - Mobile
projects.description:
PoliHeel Mobile is a React Native (Expo) app in active development that helps users discover U.S. legislators with fast search, optional location-based state filtering, and AI-generated profile summaries via a Laravel API.

• Features: full legislator directory search, location-based state delegation, legislator detail profiles, AI-generated summary per legislator

• Tech: React Native (Expo Router), TypeScript, TanStack React Query, Axios, NativeWind/Tailwind, Laravel REST API

• Engineering: typed API layer, caching + error/loading UX, Jest test coverage for API utilities/endpoints

• Status: in development (iterating on navigation/auth and expanding feature set)

projects.title: PoliHeel
projects.description:
Full-stack Nuxt application making U.S. congressional data accessible through comprehensive legislator profiles, real-time bill tracking, interactive district mapping, and AI-powered voting analysis. Built with TypeScript, Laravel backend, and modern serverless architecture to demonstrate scalable full-stack development with data visualization and AI integration.

• Built full-stack TypeScript application aggregating data for 500+ U.S. congressional legislators with real-time bill tracking, committee memberships, and voting pattern analysis

• Integrated 5+ government APIs (Congress.gov, LegiScan, VoteView, MediaWiki) with custom middleware and data standardization layer for unified access and caching

• Implemented interactive congressional district mapping using Leaflet.js with GeoJSON data visualization, enabling state-by-state district exploration

• Developed AI-powered legislator summaries and voting analysis using Anthropic Claude API with intelligent caching strategies and server-side rendering for performance

• Built Laravel REST API backend with Laravel Sanctum authentication for user follow features and session management

• Deployed serverless architecture on AWS (Lambda, S3) and Vercel with CloudFront CDN, SSR/SSG for SEO optimization, Vercel Analytics monitoring, and automated CI/CD pipelines

• Architected scalable data pipeline with AWS Lambda functions for automated data synchronization and S3 storage for congressional data, images, and GeoJSON files
